heading: Scrap Metal Bin Hire
summary: Scrap bins dropped at your site and collected when full.

seo.title: Scrap Metal Bin Hire in Hallam & SE Melbourne
seo.description: Hire a scrap metal bin from Metal Werx in Hallam, usually 1 m³ or 2.4 m³. We drop it at your home, farm or worksite, collect it when it's full and pay you by bank transfer the same day.

lede: Clearing out a shed, stripping a site or piling up offcuts? We'll drop a bin where you need it, collect it when it's full and pay you for the metal inside.

paragraphs.text: A scrap bin keeps your metal in one place while you work, instead of scattered across the yard or piled up behind the shed. Load it at your own pace, then call us when it's full and we'll take it away or swap it for an empty one.
Unlike a skip full of rubbish, a bin of scrap metal is worth something. We weigh every bin at our Hallam yard and pay you for the metal inside by bank transfer, the same day.

features.title: Dropped and collected
features.text: We place the bin where you need it and pick it up when you call.

features.title: Weighed and paid
features.text: Every bin is weighed at our yard, and you're paid for the metal by bank transfer the same day.

features.title: One-off or ongoing
features.text: Hire a bin for a single clean-out, or keep one on site and swap it as it fills.

features.title: Sized to the job
features.text: We have bins in different sizes, but most jobs end up with a 1 m³ or a 2.4 m³ bin.

steps.intro: From booking to getting paid, in four steps.

items.title: Book a bin
items.text: Tell us what you're clearing, roughly how much and where the bin should go, and we'll suggest a size, usually a 1 m³ or a 2.4 m³ bin.

items.title: We drop it off
items.text: We place the bin on firm, level ground, with room for our truck to get in and out.

items.title: Fill it with metal
items.text: Load scrap metal only, and keep out the things listed below.

items.title: We collect and pay
items.text: Call us when it's full. We take it to the yard, weigh it and pay you for the metal by bank transfer the same day.

details.heading: What Can Go in the Bin
details.intro: Our bins are for scrap metal only. Mixed metals are fine, though a clean, sorted load gets a better price. Anything that isn't metal, or isn't safe to handle, has to stay out.

faq.intro: Common questions about hiring a scrap bin.

questions.question: What size bins do you have?
questions.answer: We have bins in different sizes, but most jobs end up with a 1 m³ or a 2.4 m³ bin. Tell us what you're clearing and roughly how much, and we'll suggest the right one.

questions.question: How long can I keep the bin?
questions.answer: As long as the job takes. Some customers fill a bin in a day; others keep one on site for weeks and call us when it's full.

questions.question: Can the bin go on the street?
questions.answer: If it won't fit on your property, a bin on the road or nature strip usually needs a permit from your local council. Check with your council before you book, and we'll place the bin once it's approved.

questions.question: Can I mix different metals in one bin?
questions.answer: Yes. Mixed metal is fine, but clean, sorted metal gets a better price. If you have a lot of copper, brass or aluminium, ask us about keeping it separate.

questions.question: How do I get paid for the metal?
questions.answer: We weigh the bin at our yard and pay you by bank transfer the same day. Scrap metal dealers in Victoria can't pay in cash, so we'll need your BSB and account number, and your photo ID.

questions.question: Where do you deliver bins?
questions.answer: From our yard in Hallam across Melbourne's south-east. If you're further out, get in touch and we'll let you know if we can help.

seo.title: Scrap Metal Pickup & Collection, SE Melbourne
seo.description: Book a scrap metal pickup from Metal Werx. We collect bulk scrap and old machinery from homes, farms and businesses across Melbourne's south-east, and pay you by bank transfer the same day.

lede: Too much scrap for the ute, or too heavy to lift? We'll come to you, load it up and pay you for the metal.

paragraphs.text: Not every load fits on a trailer. Old farm machinery, steel tanks, beams, a shed full of offcuts: we bring the truck and the gear to load it, so you don't have to.
Tell us what you have and where it is, and we'll quote and book a time that suits. Everything we collect is weighed at our Hallam yard, and you're paid for the metal by bank transfer the same day.

features.title: We do the lifting
features.text: Our crew and truck load heavy and awkward items, so you don't have to.

features.title: Homes, farms and businesses
features.text: From a backyard clean-up to a paddock full of old machinery.

features.title: Booked around you
features.text: Pick a day that suits, and we'll fit in with your site.

features.title: Weighed and paid

steps.intro: Getting rid of a big load takes one call.

items.title: Tell us what you have
items.text: Call or message us with what needs collecting, roughly how much and where it is. Photos help.

items.title: Get a quote
items.text: We'll give you a price for the metal and book a pickup time that suits you.

items.title: We load it up
items.text: Our crew arrives with the right truck, loads your scrap and takes it away.

items.title: Get paid
items.text: We weigh your metal at the yard and pay you by bank transfer the same day.

faq.intro: Common questions about booking a pickup.

questions.question: Is there a charge for collection?
questions.answer: It depends on how much metal there is, what it is and how far we have to travel. We'll tell you before we book the pickup, so there are no surprises.

questions.question: Do you collect from farms and rural properties?
questions.answer: Yes. We collect old machinery, implements, tanks, fencing and other farm scrap. Tell us what's there and how to get to it, and we'll bring the right truck.

questions.question: What do I need to have ready?
questions.answer: Clear access for our truck, plus your photo ID and bank details. Victorian law requires us to record the ID of everyone who sells us scrap, and we pay by bank transfer the same day, not in cash.

questions.question: Can you take an old car at the same time?
questions.answer: Yes. We buy cars, utes, vans and trucks in any condition, running or not, and tow them away for free. You'll need proof that you own the vehicle and photo ID.

questions.question: My load is small. Should I book a pickup?
questions.answer: If it fits in a car, ute or trailer, it's usually quickest to bring it to our Hallam yard yourself. For anything bigger, get in touch.

seo.title: Commercial Scrap Metal Recycling
seo.description: Ongoing scrap metal recycling for workshops, fabricators, builders and manufacturers in Melbourne's south-east. Bins on site, scheduled swaps and same-day payment for every load.

lede: Regular scrap removal for workshops, fabricators, builders and manufacturers. We keep your site clear and pay you for the metal.

paragraphs.text: If your business turns out offcuts, swarf, old stock or worn-out equipment, that metal has value. We set you up with bins sized to your output and a pickup schedule that matches how fast you fill them.

Every load is weighed at our Hallam yard and paid for by bank transfer the same day, with a weigh ticket for your records. Keeping metals apart on site gets you a better price, and we'll help you set that up.

features.title: Bins on site
features.text: Bins placed where your team works, sized to how much metal you produce: usually 1 m³ or 2.4 m³.

features.title: Scheduled or on call
features.text: Swaps on a set day each week, or whenever you call to say a bin's full.

features.title: A ticket for every load
features.text: Each load is weighed and ticketed, so you can track what you've recycled.

features.title: Sorted for better prices
features.text: Separate bins for copper, brass, aluminium or stainless earn more than a mixed load.

steps.intro: We'll set up a service that fits your business.

items.title: Talk to us
items.text: Tell us which metals you produce, roughly how much, and how often.

items.title: We set you up
items.text: We drop off bins to suit your metals and your space, and agree a pickup schedule.

items.title: We swap the bins
items.text: Full bins are swapped for empty ones, so your team never has to stop work.

items.title: You get paid
items.text: Each load is weighed at our yard and paid for by bank transfer the same day, with a weigh ticket.

faq.intro: Common questions about recycling scrap from your business.

questions.question: Do you work with small businesses?
questions.answer: Yes. Whether you're a one-person workshop or a large manufacturer, we'll set up bins and pickups to suit how much metal you produce.

questions.question: Can we have separate bins for different metals?
questions.answer: Yes, and it's worth doing. Clean, sorted metal gets a better price than a mixed load, so keeping copper, brass, aluminium and stainless steel apart from steel pays off.

questions.question: What if we only fill a bin now and then?
questions.answer: That's fine. Keep a bin on site and call us when it's full, instead of booking regular swaps.

questions.question: How are we paid?
questions.answer: By bank transfer, the same day each load is weighed. Scrap metal dealers in Victoria can't pay in cash.

questions.question: Do you provide paperwork for our records?
questions.answer: Yes. Every load comes with a weigh ticket showing the metal and its weight.

cta.heading: Let's Talk About Your Scrap
cta.text: Tell us what your business produces and we'll set up a service to match.
